notes: Deployment confirmation uses PluginServer.getInstalledPlugins(), not HostedPluginServer.getDeployedPluginIds(): HostedPluginServerImpl.isInstalledPlugin pins a plugin id to the version seen at session start, so a newly deployed version can never appear in getDeployedPluginIds() within the same session (measured: still 2.1.210 five minutes after the new version was on disk).

Theia's PluginDeployerHandlerImpl.markAsInstalled already removes other versions of the same id when a new version is deployed; the explicit uninstall of the old version is kept anyway (idempotent, does not rely on that behaviour).
